column1: # Evidence for 烏瞰圖 (wu kan tu)
#   the middle group is nailed: k from 苦(ku3) + a-with-diacritic and n from 弹(dan4)
#   TONES ARE NOT RECOVERABLE from the drawing: a split box only says "this letter
#   carries a dot or a diacritic", which is identical for the four tones.  So the
#   footer encodes the LETTERS  w? / kan / t?  only.
#   all four characters of CN_-6_L and CN_+6_R share one left radical: the left
#   three columns of all four room maps match, cell for cell, ONLY 女-radical
#   characters (65 of them, no other radical) -> artifacts/partfilter.py
#   CN_-6_L#2 : best 女-radical char with letter-shape [.][.][V] = 姝 shu1 (#26, 0.909)
#               runner-up 妷 zhi2 gives "i" but "wi" is not a pinyin syllable;
#               next admissible is 媰 chu2 -> also "u".  => letter 1 = u
#   CN_+6_R#1 : best 女-radical chars with [.][V] = 嬉 xi1 (#34), 婦 fu4 (#77, 0.904),
#               媍 fu4 (#177), 娛 yu2 (#239)  => letter = u (or i)
#   => w u   k a n   t u  = 烏瞰圖, Yi Sang's 1934 poem cycle (a pun on 鳥瞰圖).
#   It sits in the KOREAN panel, exactly as 『春と修羅』(Japanese) sits in the
#   JAPANESE panel => the Chinese panel's footer must be a CHINESE work.
# Evidence for 봄과 아수라
#   JP_+1_R#4  = 過 (과)   model rank 1, 0.892; marker layout = compound vowel, no batchim
#   JP_+1_R#3  = 搬 (반)   model rank 1 among vert3, 0.907  -> 초성 ㅂ, 중성 ㅏ
#   JP_+1_L#1  = 蹣 (만)   model rank 1 among vert3, 0.916  -> 초성 ㅁ, 중성 ㅏ
#   footer syl1 = ㅂ + ㅗ(from 銃 총) + ㅁ = 봄 ; syl2 = 과 ; then 아 수 라
# Kana footer, resolved: はくちゅうむ = 白昼夢 = 北岛《白日梦》
#   KR_+4_L = 薄明 (薄 はく)  -> boxes 1,2   [the 艹-head read off rows 0-2 was right]
#   KR_+8_R = 山地 (地 ち)    -> box 3
#   KR_-3_L = 笹の雪 (雪 ゆき) -> box 4, drawn half-size because it is a SMALL kana
#            in the target string; note cell 2 of that word is the hiragana の.
#   KR_+8_L = 氷霧 (氷 ひょう) -> box 5 = う ; (霧 む) -> box 6
